notes: P1: the one focus primitive (10a-spec §1) on each host: Card, Btn primary/secondary, Chip, NavItem, Sources row.
Rest = the host drawn with focus elsewhere; lit = ring (160 ms) + spring (~320 ms) at rest, so settle >= 600 ms.
Home opens with focus on the hero's Play (primary Btn, hasTVPreferredFocus). DOWN moves to row 0 card 0.
Fixture assumption: /api/home rows are [continue (frame cards), recent (NEW), mixed rows...]; row 2 is the first poster row.
Chips live in Browse's filter panel: RIGHT from the LAST column of the grid opens it (280 ms slide), so the path walks the first row to its end first; focus lands on the active category chip (on).
Sources row: Detail of ${id1} (a film the library owns, so Detail shows the Versions button) -> the Sources panel; set --var id1=<library id>.
Traces: focus.ring / focus.spring are the element GAINING focus after the LAST key; the one losing it logs focus.ring.out / focus.spring.out.

states.name: card-rest
states.note: focus on hero Play; every card in every row unlit (ring 0, scale 1, highlight 0)

states.name: card-lit
states.note: row 0 card 0 lit: ring on after 160 ms, scale/lift spring at rest; Play's ring fading out is traced too (.out). hero.ty / hero.atTop are the hero's own states (hero.json), not traced here

states.name: btn-primary-lit
states.note: hero Play (primary) lit at launch (no key, so nothing to trace: the ring went up during the launch)

states.name: btn-primary-rest
states.note: focus moved to Details: Play (primary) at rest, Details (secondary) lit

states.name: btn-secondary-lit
states.note: same frame as btn-primary-rest but traced: Details' ring and spring

states.name: btn-secondary-rest
states.note: Details unlit while Play is lit (same capture as btn-primary-lit, kept as its own row in the table)

states.name: chip-on-lit
states.note: RIGHT x5 walks the first grid row to its last column, the sixth RIGHT (from the edgeRight card) opens the filter panel (280 ms slide); focus lands on the active category chip 'All' (on + lit, light ring)

states.name: chip-lit
states.note: 'Trending' lit (bare, not on); 'All' is on at rest — the same frame covers chip rest (every other chip), chip lit and chip on

states.name: chip-rest
states.note: 'New' lit; 'Trending' back at rest after a lit->rest transition (ring release, spring back to 1)

states.name: chip-surface-lit
states.note: seven DOWNs: past the Genre picker to the surface chip 'Unwatched' (rgba fill + 1 dp edge), lit

states.name: navitem-lit
states.note: LEFT on Play opens the rail (rail-opener path, 10d §4); focus lands on the active section's NavItem 'Home' (lit)

states.name: sources-row-lit
states.note: Detail of an OWNED film (${id1}): DOWN from Play to the icon row (My List), RIGHT x2 to Versions, OK opens the Sources panel; its first row ('In your library', highlight wash + white ring, noScale) lit. NEVER press OK again on this screen (a row plays, Save downloads). The list comes from the server's source search: if a seeder count changes between A and B the diff says so in the text, not in the ring.

states.name: sources-row-lit-2
states.note: as sources-row-lit, then DOWN: the first torrent row lit, the library row back at rest (lit -> rest)
